title: cuitlauzina pendula f. rosella
intro: Cuitlauzina pendula f. rosella, commonly known as the Mexican hanging flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cuitlauzina pendula f. rosella include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and preventing the growth of microorganisms. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
